| ✅  | The PR template is filled in: description, `Fixes: #29766`, testing notes, before/after screenshots and a screen recording. |
| ℹ️  | Some self-review boxes are unchecked (responsiveness, strings and tooltips, corner cases). The description also says the tooltip question is still waiting on design feedback. |
| ℹ️  | CI status isn't available. The label may have been about failing tests, so check CI before the review starts. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm. She added the label, the author pinged her, and she has 23 commits on these files.

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign @laurynmm.
